name: statistics
description: Get task statistics for the specified filters.

params.name: limit
params.description: Only list this amount of tasks. (0 means no limit)

params.name: since
params.description: Only list tasks since this UNIX epoch.

params.name: start
params.description: List tasks beginning from this offset.

params.name: statusfilter
params.description: Only list tasks which have any one of the listed status.

params.name: typefilter
params.description: Only list tasks whose type contains this.

params.name: until
params.description: Only list tasks until this UNIX epoch.

params.name: userfilter
params.description: Only list tasks from this user.

returns.description: Lists the task status counts by type and by remote

by-remote.description: A map of remotes to status counts

by-type.description: A map of worker-types to status counts

permissions.description: Resource.Audit privileges on /resource/{remote} are needed to list tasks from a given remote.
